chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa'd bin Abdullah, of Qasim bin Muhammad, of Sulayman bin Dawud al-Manqari, of Hafs bin Ghiyath, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «His Chair extends over the Heavens and the earth»

key_terms.كُرْسِيُّهُ: His Chair (a metaphor for divine attribute)

ai.seo_question: What does the 'Chair' (Kursi) of Allah refer to in the Quran according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the 'Chair' (Kursi) in Surah Al-A'raf not as a physical entity but as Allah's Knowledge, distinguishing it from the 'Throne' (Arsh). This interpretation aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition of *ta'wil* (esoteric interpretation), emphasizing that divine attributes are understood through their functional realities rather than literal spatial dimensions, thereby affirming Allah's transcendence over physical containment.

about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «His Chair extends over the Heavens and the earth» .
